contea di ritrovamento: Rutland (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of an indeterminate early Roman ruler, probably issue of AD 43-100. Obverse description: Head laureate right; thick neck. Obverse inscription: [--]A[---]IIII[---]. Reverse description: Central legend, horizontal over two lines. Reverse inscription: [---]OMIVS / VO[-]M[?I]R. Diameter: 18.3mm, Weight: 3.09gms, die axis: 10
